description: A young British woman of about twenty, clear mezzo voice, received pronunciation, quick and dry, witty and composed, amused edge, never breathless, precise diction.
text: A bet against the room. Charlotte does love a sure thing. Sir William, does St James's teach a man to refuse a partner? He claimed the set. I never said yes, and I never once said no. I find the chandelier equally riveting, Mr Darcy; shall we compare notes?
